==Dialogue==
:''"There was a time I was a respected [[redemptor]]. [[Kurzick]]s from all [[House]]s came together to listen to my sermons. But then...I failed my people and shamed my [[god]]s. By allowing my body to be transformed into a [[Kurzick Juggernaut|juggernaut]], I hope that the gods will grant me mercy and forgiveness.

:''Please, help me get to the [[The Eternal Grove (outpost)|Eternal Grove]] safely so that I can begin my repentance."''
